subject.title: [Bug]: codexPlugins activation stalls every embedded-Codex turn — plugin/list timed out / LOCAL_REQUEST_CANCELLED; curated marketplace + plugin/install contract drift vs Codex 0.143+

question: When an explicitly configured native Codex plugin cannot be listed, resolved, or activated, should the Codex turn continue with no plugin apps or should thread setup remain fail-closed?
rationale: The contract-adaptation bug is mechanical, but current documentation and tests treat missing plugin evidence as fail-closed; changing that boundary affects operator expectations and plugin trust policy.

options.title: Continue Without Apps
options.body: Emit structured activation diagnostics, expose no affected apps, and allow the underlying Codex model turn to proceed.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed
options.body: Preserve thread failure but fix marketplace resolution, install arguments, timeout attribution, and error reporting so failures are immediate and accurate.

recommendation.title: Continue Without Apps
recommendation.body: Emit structured activation diagnostics, expose no affected apps, and allow the underlying Codex model turn to proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the current native Codex activation and marketplace topology and is the strongest available history signal for this boundary.
